_about: J. W. McCrindle (1825-1913), translator of the Greek and Latin writers on India: Ancient India as Described by Ktesias the Knidian (1882), Ancient India as Described by Ptolemy (1885), The Commerce and Navigation of the Erythraean Sea (the Periplus and Arrian's Indika part 2, 1879; this scan a 1966 microfilm-xerographic reprint of that edition, no new matter), The Christian Topography of Cosmas (Hakluyt Society, 1897), and Ancient India as Described in Classical Literature (1901). His Megasthenes and his Invasion of India by Alexander are on the arrian shelf. Classical scholarship (lane B, round df). Raw IA OCR. No uids minted.
